reviews.comment: Professor Wilcox made the course content engaging and interesting. The only challenge was the exams, as they covered a lot of material and were written in a tricky way. Even he admitted that the first two exams were too difficult and included trick questions. Despite that, the class was enjoyable and informative overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Wilcox's grad level consumer behavior class was one of the hardest classes I took this semester, surprisingly. He is very smart, but doesn't know how to simplify the subjects he is teaching in a way that makes it comprehensible. He is not tech savvy either. The hardest part of his class were his exams because he would overload us with content.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Professor overall, he was an amazing lecturer and made every single class exciting. I am very happy I took his MKTG 322 as an elective class and I would 100% recommend him to others. Tests have H=high b to low a test averages and he is very accessible outside of class. He is the best lecturer I have had so far at Tamu.
